key_insight: FokasNets use the Fokas method’s Global Relation to supply missing boundary data, improving physics-informed neural solutions and solution operators.
engineering_relevance: More accurate boundary completion could improve PDE-based engineering models when only mixed or incomplete boundary information is available.
method: Use lifted neural representations that impose Dirichlet conditions by construction and learn interior corrections.
Add a Global Relation solve during training to recover missing boundary data.
Develop Fokas-PINNs and Fokas Operator Networks for elliptic and evolution PDEs, with error, stability, and universal approximation analysis.
evidence_signal: Manufactured-solution tests and literature benchmarks show accuracy gains over standard and lifted PINNs and Physics-Informed DeepONets, reaching multiple orders of magnitude for solution operators and error thresholds faster during training.
watch_item: Deployment requires a suitable Global Relation formulation and an additional training-time solve; the abstract does not quantify that solve’s computational overhead.
paper_title: FokasNets: Completing missing boundary data in Physics-Informed Neural Networks and Operators via the Global Relation
